title: pvVisItCTRLReader
body:
## pvVisItCTRLReader

Reads the control (ctrl) input file of the TB-LMTO (tight-binding linear muffin-tin orbital) electronic-structure code: the atom sites become a point mesh named "mesh" with a point array "element". VisIt's element-name labels and unit-cell metadata are not converted by the bridge, so the result is a point cloud of sites, not a molecule with bonds. FileName takes a list of files, each one time step of a series (ParaView's file-series wrapper).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Convert or glyph the points yourself; no bonds or unit-cell box are produced.
- Name the arrays you need in PointArrayStatus and CellArrayStatus: the VisIt bridge starts with every variable unselected, so omitting them normally gives geometry without fields.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue and has not run a native acceptance check for this reader; check meshes, arrays and times on your own data.

Native constructor: `VisItCTRLReader`. Identity: `sources/VisItCTRLReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the zone-centred (cell) variables to read from TB-LMTO ctrl data; each becomes a cell-data array on every selected mesh that defines it. Vector variables arrive as one multi-component array, while VisIt expressions and tensor, label, species and array variables are not converted by the bridge. The TB-LMTO ctrl plugin declares its variables node-centred, so this list normally stays empty. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MaterialStatus` | Names of materials to convert into volume-fraction cell arrays. For each selected material the bridge adds a float cell array named after it: 1 in cells made only of that material, its volume fraction in mixed cells and -1 where it is absent. The TB-LMTO ctrl plugin defines no materials, so this list has nothing to select. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MeshStatus` | Names of the TB-LMTO ctrl meshes to read. Each selected mesh becomes one named block of the multiblock output and unlisted meshes are skipped. The CTRL plugin reports one point mesh named "mesh" holding the atom sites. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of the node-centred (point) variables to read from TB-LMTO ctrl data; each becomes a point-data array on every selected mesh that defines it. Vector variables arrive as one multi-component array, while VisIt expressions and tensor, label, species and array variables are not converted by the bridge. For TB-LMTO ctrl data these are one node-centred variable, "element" (the element of each atom site). | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvVisItCTRLReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
